meta.title: Dorothy (dot)
meta.description: An always-on coordinator: talk to Dorothy in her own panel, and she opens workspaces, starts sessions, follows their progress, settles approvals and questions for you, and reports back.

panel.cardsHint: You can still answer expired cards; replies reach the current conversation.
panel.agreementsHint: The rules you set, kept in your own words. They win over her cognition.
panel.agreementsPlaceholder: - e.g. Pushing to my personal repos is fine
panel.cognitionHint: Dorothy's own reading of how you like to work. She writes it; you can edit it.
panel.cognitionPlaceholder: What she has noticed about your preferences and rhythm…

settings.taskPermissionDesc: Applies to new tasks, independently of approval routing. Windows tests failing with spawn EPERM may need approval for a wider retry.
settings.reflectionDesc: Reviews recent work when idle and updates her cognition; flags stale or conflicting agreements the next time you message her, for you to decide.

context.promptSectionsHint: What this segment actually carries in its prompt.
